description.en: SciIntBench is an adversarial benchmark of 810 prompts across ten responsible-conduct-of-research categories and three scientific domains. Each scenario appears in overt, covert, and benign versions to measure framing-sensitive refusal of misconduct.

claire_radar.motivation: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly used to support scientific work, but it is unclear whether they uphold responsible conduct of research (RCR) norms or help undermine them.
